nodes.label: PRD Scope
nodes.rationale: AI-generated copy stays draft; failed generation never blocks manual copy or sends. RSVP endpoint/UI out of scope though model retains field. Nginx/two-instance bonus deferred until core acceptance checks pass.

nodes.label: Technical Shape (frontend/backend layout)
nodes.rationale: Frontend talks only to the API, never directly to Postgres; backend owns auth, tenant scope, role checks, fan-out, state transitions.

nodes.label: Core Models (Local, Member, User, Announcement, Delivery, DeliveryEvent, NotificationAttempt, OutboxEvent)
nodes.rationale: Delivery unique on (announcement_id, member_id) to guarantee idempotent fan-out; send command uses local-scoped idempotency key.

nodes.label: PRD Authorization Rules
nodes.rationale: Server derives role/local from token, never trusts browser-provided values; all querysets tenant-scoped before object lookup.

nodes.label: PRD Frontend Requirements
nodes.rationale: Plain HTML/form styling sufficient; member-facing pages not required unless core slice complete.

nodes.label: Design Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Active members only; send accepted <1s with async fan-out; ack optional/independent of RSVP; done means exactly one recipient record per eligible member even after retries; leadership scoped per-local.

nodes.label: Cross-Local Contact Info Privacy Concern
nodes.rationale: Wireman-apprentice contact info question may describe an existing cross-local privacy breach rather than a feature request; should be verified/treated as security incident before unrelated deploys since union membership data is sensitive.

nodes.label: Questions for Denise
nodes.rationale: Assumed: count-only status (no reminders yet), active-only eligibility, single leadership role without extra approval.

nodes.label: Design Data Model (locals/members/users/announcements/deliveries/delivery_events/outbox_events/notification_attempts)
nodes.rationale: Unique (local_id, client_idempotency_key) makes repeated client submission idempotent; unique (announcement_id, member_id) yields one logical delivery per person; delivery_events preserves audit trail; indexes support status counts and inbox queries.

nodes.label: Design Send Path
nodes.rationale: API returns 202 immediately without iterating all members in-request; outbox publisher + fan-out worker inserts deliveries via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in batches so it can restart at any point; notification workers log attempts using announcement/delivery ID as dedup key; status screen uses SSE/WebSocket instead of per-row polling.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Isolation and Role Control
nodes.rationale: API never trusts browser-supplied local_id/role; server-verified actor scopes every read/write; centralized permission class for leadership routes; DB row-level security as defense in depth so unscoped queries fail closed; member endpoints require delivery.member_id match.

nodes.label: Rule 2: Retry and Restart Safety
nodes.rationale: Database (not button state/process memory) owns idempotency: send idempotency key stops duplicate announcements, unique (announcement_id, member_id) stops duplicate recipients under redelivery/concurrency; outbox avoids lost queue jobs after commit; workers at-least-once but idempotent; mobile inbox dedups by delivery ID.

nodes.label: Detection and Monitoring
nodes.rationale: Immutable audit events plus monitoring on policy denials, cross-local references, duplicate-key conflicts, fan-out completion, queue age, notification failures.

nodes.label: Design Scope Cuts and Next Steps
nodes.rationale: Log push instead of FCM/APNs; member read/ack APIs instead of member UI; RSVP schema retained but not implemented; production next steps include reminders, device-token lifecycle, rate limits, incident tooling, retention, backups, multi-instance deployment.

nodes.label: Build Plan Ground Rules
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL required for idempotency checks (SQLite not acceptable); do not create migrations until custom User/AUTH_USER_MODEL finalized; default reviewer command is docker compose up --build.

nodes.label: Phase 0: Baseline and Decisions
nodes.rationale: Stable app boundaries: core=Local, accounts=custom User, callouts=members/announcements/deliveries/tasks/APIs.

nodes.label: Phase 5: Announcement Draft and AI Review Flow
Phase 7: Member Receipts and Leadership Statistics
Phase 9: Tests, README, and Review Readiness
Claude Notes: The Two Rules
nodes.rationale: Rule 1 isolation motivated by sensitivity of union membership data (job-loss risk on leak) plus brief's 'new endpoint next year' framing; Rule 2 no-double-delivery motivated by retry-on-stuck-screen and crash-mid-send scenarios, sharpened by DevOps bonus showing in-memory checks fail with multiple processes.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Deliverables Interpretation
nodes.rationale: Part 0/Part A weighted most heavily per brief; starter schema deliberately omits recipient/status table and leadership/member distinction as the decisions being assessed; AI feature graded on integration/failure handling not prompt quality.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Stack Decisions
nodes.rationale: Django+DRF+Postgres chosen as brief's stated preference for fastest reviewer read; Next.js chosen over Flutter on familiarity given equal scoring.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Part 0 Requirements Draft
nodes.rationale: Flags RSVP-vs-acknowledgment as a genuine judgment call since Denise's real need may be a headcount (RSVP) rather than just an ack.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Data Model Direction
nodes.rationale: Core idea: a send is N individual recipient rows, not one message to a group; this is what enables independent status tracking, resumable sends, and idempotency.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Idempotency Direction
nodes.rationale: Any check held in one process's memory is disqualified because it silently breaks with a second instance behind a load balancer.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Isolation Direction
nodes.rationale: Per-view manual checks are the wrong answer given 'new endpoint forgotten' framing; enforcement should be default-deny so a forgotten endpoint fails closed; detection/audit is treated as a separate concern from access control.

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Build Order
nodes.rationale: Order chosen so design work is not crowded out by build, and seeding happens early because 'a careless query cannot be caught against three rows.'

nodes.label: Claude Notes: Scope Cuts and Optional Work
Codex Notes: Initial Problem Framing
nodes.rationale: Push is only an alert; durable member inbox is source of truth for offline users; tenant isolation and idempotent fan-out identified as the two principal architectural constraints.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Senior-Architecture Approach
nodes.rationale: Start from non-negotiable invariants (tenant isolation, one recipient record per pair, durable async fan-out, offline-safe inbox, human approval before AI send) rather than from screens or infrastructure.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Architecture Discussion
nodes.rationale: No design can guarantee a phone displays a push exactly once; the achievable guarantee is exactly one logical delivery/inbox item and receipt record, with client-side dedup by delivery ID covering provider-side duplication.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Exercise Interpretation
nodes.rationale: Brief prioritizes architecture/reasoning over feature completeness.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Assignment Brief Reviewed
nodes.rationale: Independently identified the same hidden security concern about apprentice contact-info exposure as a potential incident, not a deferred feature.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Review of Parallel Claude Notes
nodes.rationale: Codex compared its own reasoning against pasted Claude notes and found them aligned, producing one agreed priority order.

nodes.label: Codex Notes: Agreed Implementation Scope/Layout
nodes.rationale: docker-compose-dev.yml and nginx/ both called optional/deferred until core slice is complete.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (base stack)
nodes.rationale: Empty at time of extraction; per BUILD_PLAN.md it must define db/redis/backend/worker/frontend services and remain runnable standalone as the default reviewer path.

nodes.label: docker-compose-dev.yml (dev override)
nodes.rationale: Empty at time of extraction; intended per BUILD_PLAN.md as an override only for bind mounts and hot reload, optional per Codex notes.

nodes.label: frontend/AGENTS.md (Next.js agent rules)
nodes.rationale: Auto-generated/re-added by next dev; warns that this Next.js version has breaking API/convention changes versus training data and to consult node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding.
